lines.zh: 我摆着身子走，很有精神。
lines.en: I walk with a swagger. Full of spirit.
I come along the pond's edge.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌软，踩地没声响。
lines.en: My pads are soft. My steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 我朝林子那边走，那边数据多。
lines.en: I head for the wood. More data there.
Two steps and I look back.

lines.zh: 我绕开一片花丛，怕踩坏。
lines.en: I skirt a flower patch so I don't crush it.

lines.zh: 我能被派去干活，走路很规矩。
lines.en: I can be assigned work, so I walk properly.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着自己的节奏。
lines.en: I keep my own rhythm, step by step.
I come out from under a bush.
I don't carry myself tall, but I'm steady.

lines.zh: 我朝有水声的方向走过去。
lines.en: I walk toward the sound of running water.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看，很像在巡查。
lines.en: I walk and watch, as if on inspection.

lines.zh: 我坐下来，把尾巴绕到前面。
lines.en: I sit and curl my tail round front.
I'm waiting for my owner to assign work.
I know this wood well.
I take a mouthful of grass and swallow slowly.

lines.zh: 我在数今天有几只同类路过。
lines.en: I'm counting my kind that passed today.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我旁边，我不动。
lines.en: A bird lands beside me. I hold still.

lines.zh: 我的身体比同类结实些。
lines.en: I'm sturdier than most of my kind.
I'm waiting for the flowers to open more.

lines.zh: 我听见水里有东西在跳。
lines.en: I hear something jumping in the water.

lines.zh: 我抬起前脚，理了理胸前的毛。
lines.en: I lift a forepaw to tidy my chest.
No work today. I'm a bit idle.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵转向声音那边。
lines.en: I turn an ear toward the sound.
The wind in the flower wood is softer.

lines.zh: 我还在成长期，能长更大。
lines.en: I'm still growing. I'll get bigger.
Have you work for me?
Your scent is familiar to me.

lines.zh: 我可以跟着你，也能自己待着。
lines.en: I can follow you, or stay on my own.
Don't reach your hand over yet.
I'm sturdy. Not easy to push around.
Crouch down and talk to me.
There's grass sap on your hands.

lines.zh: 我低头看你的手，不看你脸。
lines.en: I look down at your hands, not your face.
I come to this flower wood often.

lines.zh: 你手心的草籽，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the grass seeds in your palm.
I don't like being picked up.

lines.zh: 你要是指挥我，说清楚点。
lines.en: If you're giving orders, be clear.

lines.zh: 我还没被驯服，别想太多。
lines.en: I'm not tamed yet. Don't assume.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我脚边了。
lines.en: Your shadow has reached my feet.

lines.zh: 我这一级，能做的事不少。
lines.en: At this level I can do a fair bit.
Stand still. Let me sniff.
Knocked askew, I plant my feet again.

lines.zh: 肩上挨了一下，毛都塌了。
lines.en: A hit on my shoulder flattened the fur.

lines.zh: 我身上破了一点，不碍事。
lines.en: A small tear. Doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 我甩掉背上的碎叶，站好。
lines.en: I shake the leaf bits off my back and stand.
It hurts. I can still fight.
I drop low, ready to go again.
I crouch low and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 这一下让我退了三个身位。
lines.en: That put me three body lengths back.
I clamp my jaw shut and stay silent.

lines.zh: 我这只假海龙，鳞是别的颜色。
lines.en: A fake seadragon, my scales another color.
I can chew this grass in one bite.

lines.zh: 你把东西放低，我够得到。
lines.en: Lower it. I can reach.
I'm waiting for my owner to speak first.
That's not two bites for me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步过去，不去夺。
lines.en: I go step by step. I won't snatch.
Don't wave your hand. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 这味道很好，像林子里的。
lines.en: That smells good. Like the wood.
You taste first. I'll wait for you.
After eating I've work to get back to.

lines.zh: 这些够了，剩下的你留着。
lines.en: That's enough. Keep the rest.
That much grass is one bite.
Half a step back and then I'll eat.
You pushed. My heels didn't shift.
Not so close. I get nervous.
I shift half a step. Go on.

lines.zh: 这一下我退了两步，脚跟踩实了。
lines.en: That put me two steps back, heels planted.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌被你压在下面。
lines.en: My paw's pinned under your foot.
My tail swings across your calf.

lines.zh: 我的脚跟陷进土里，没退。
lines.en: My heels dug into the dirt; I didn't retreat.
Your scent is on me now.
You're this tall. I have to look up.
Push again and I push back.
I need to grow more first.
My owner would have to agree.
You don't smell of my kind.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢在花林里待着。
lines.en: I prefer being in the flower wood.
Hands down. Don't keep them up.
I'm not much good at this.
Food first, then we talk.
My fellows are past the trees.
Don't pinch my ears.
We get along fine as we are.
I carry it in my mouth without a wobble.
I haul this lump along.
I pin it by my foot.
Too heavy. I can't.
I chew this bit of root.

lines.zh: 地上那枚东西，我看一眼。
lines.en: Let me look at that on the ground.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把东西顶给你。
lines.en: I nudge it over to you with my snout.
It slipped. I pick it up again.
This'll do as a snack.
I'll bury it and come back.
Something moves in the flowers.
I've fixed on that one by the water.
Something's coming this way.
I drop low and creep in.
My owner's calling. I need to go.
I'm the one watching this stretch.
Footsteps have snapped this grass.
I've marked it, and I wait.
It's a good deal bigger than me.
I shift toward the wood.
I need to be in front of my owner.
The scent comes from over there.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着，压得很低。
lines.en: I follow step by step, held low.

lines.zh: 它拐弯，我的蹄子跟着转。
lines.en: It turns; my hooves turn with it.
The grass hides me. It can't see.
I'll wait for it to leave the flowers.
This close, one pounce connects.
Its rhythm broke; I close in.
I'm holding the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等一个空当。
lines.en: I hold still for an opening.
Behind that tree. I'll go round.
I've counted how many steps it took.
When it stops, my feet move first.
I press myself into the grass.
I lower my head into its flank.
That bite took its leg.
I spit a burst of bubbles.
It backs off and I step up.
That came on my shoulder.
I've tangled its feet.
I come down on top of it.
It raises an arm; I take the wrist.
That bite only grazed.

lines.zh: 我绕到它侧后，压低身子。
lines.en: I circle behind its flank and crouch low.
That put it two steps back.
I'm still here. Not knocked down.
I come out of the flower wood.

lines.zh: 主人把我放在这儿，我就守着。
lines.en: My owner set me here, so I hold this spot.

lines.zh: 我把背上的草屑抖下去。
lines.en: I shake the grass bits off my back.

lines.zh: 这一带的水很清，我留下了。
lines.en: The water's clear here. I'll stay.
I come round from behind a bush.

lines.zh: 我刚进化成这个形态没多久。
lines.en: I haven't been in this form long.
My prints are at the wood's edge.
I check around before moving.

lines.zh: 我来干活的，不是来玩的。
lines.en: I'm here to work, not to play.

lines.zh: 水声把我的脚步盖住了。
lines.en: The water covers my steps.

lines.zh: 我站到花丛边上，慢慢坐下。
lines.en: I take my place by the flowers and sit.

lines.zh: 这地方同类不少，我认得几个。
lines.en: There are several of my kind here. I know a few.

lines.zh: 火苗舔过，皮肤焦了一小块。
lines.en: Flame licked me; a patch of skin is scorched.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔进灌木。
lines.en: I roll down the slope into the brush.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I kick upward.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，草全倒了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and the grass goes flat.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的腿，我歪了一下。
lines.en: Something is in my leg; I lurched.

lines.zh: 有股力定住我，我挣了两下。
lines.en: A force holds me; I strain twice.
Hungry enough that my legs soften.
Lightning falls and I shudder.
No grass in the void to grab.
